name: Sow rations; mix with additives
description: This unit process dataset models the production of rations for one pig in a sow barn.  This process includes upstream unit processes for corn, soybean meal, and various feed additives.  The applicable classification is ISIC 0145.
category: 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/1122: Hog and Pig Farming

location.name: United States of America, North Carolina

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data for this project were collected from 2007 through 2014.  Pig production data is based on modeled results and considered to be generally representative of this time period.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This unit process represents production in the US Swine Production Region #4, which includes the state of North Carolina.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: This unit process includes the material inputs for a feed mix used in a sow barn.  Mixing equipment and preparation methods are not included.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Requires upstream unit processes from DataSmart for the production of select feed additives, in addition to upstream unit processes from within this dataset.  Dicalcium phosphate was used as a surrogate for monocalcium phosphate.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: This is a gate-to-gate process for the production of sow barn rations
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: The LCI data for the production of the feed ration mix used in a sow barn were obtained from the University of Arkansas Pig Production Environmental Calculator (PPEC).  The PPEC uses mathematical relationships to simulate swine growth, feed intake and water consumption, electricity and natural gas use, manure handling, and greenhouse gas emissions during each production cycle, which includes sow, nursery, and grow barns.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Flow values used in this project dataset were obtained from a variety of sources, including the 2007 NASS Census of Agriculture and University of Arkansas Pig Production Environmental Calculator (PPEC) process model simulations of the pig production process.  The total amount of rations required for the sow barn were obtained from the PPEC model.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data for this project was collected from 2007 to 2014. Unit process data were compiled in 2014.

sources.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by the University of Arkansas Center for Agricultural and Rural Sustainability for the United States Department of Agriculture National Agriculture Library.  This project was supported in part by the National Pork Board.

publication.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

dataSetOwner.name: University of Arkansas Office for Sustainability
